relations.myth: The Wild Hunter pursues the Salgfräulein
relations.note: The Wild Hunter pursues and hunts the Salgfräulein in Tyrolean tradition.
Laurin curses the laughing Saligen and transforms them into flowers called Schlernhexen.
One Christian etiological variant makes supernatural women Adam's children, whom he concealed from God.
Adam conceals the supernatural women from God, leaving them outside ordinary human history.

relations.myth: Hitte Hatte and the giant Jordan
relations.note: Jordan hunts, captures, imprisons, and kills Saligen, intending to eat one captive.
The captive Salige Hitte Hatte is forced to serve Jordan before escaping.

relations.myth: Hitte Hatte and the giant Jordan
relations.note: Jordan's Wildfrau persuades him to retain a captured Salige as a servant.
